title: KTransformers x SGLang integration
supports: KTransformers (SOSP'25) uses NUMA-aware tensor parallelism that places expert weight slices in each NUMA node's local memory; up to 63% decode gain on dual-socket systems; --kt-threadpool-count 2 for dual socket (via search snippet)

title: Kimi on Epyc
supports: No measured single-socket EPYC 9005 Kimi K2 decode figure; posters cite estimates of 10-20 tok/s, poster expects sub-10 tok/s (via search snippet)

title: AMD EPYC 9005 Architecture Overview (58462)
supports: Each CCD connects to the IOD by a GMI link; 'wide' OPNs give each CCD two GMI interfaces (8-CCD example). Used to DROP a per-CCD fabric-ceiling objection for the 8-CCD 9455 (via search snippet)

title: DDR4T04G72 datasheet (DS 60S 219460)
supports: DDR4T04G72 x72 MCP is 15 x 20 x 1.92 mm, 391 balls at 0.8 mm pitch; datasheet covers 4GB and 8GB versions (via search snippet)

title: Teledyne e2v DDR4T04G72M NPI
supports: Same 15 x 20 x 1.92 mm dimensions; package described as a Multi-Chip Package (via search snippet)

title: Teledyne e2v now shipping flight models of its space DDR4 memory solution
supports: Teledyne DDR4 offered in industrial (-40 to 105 C) and military (-55 to 125 C) temperature grades (via search snippet)

title: IEC 62435-5:2017 preview (die and wafer devices)
supports: IEC 62435-5 table of contents includes bare-die deterioration mechanisms, inert atmosphere purity, wire bondability and storage time limits; used with IEC 62435-1 for storage >12 months (via search snippet)

title: BS EN 62435-5 Long-term storage: die and wafer devices
supports: Standard covers singulated bare die and partial/complete wafers; compliant storage does not guarantee parts work at end of storage (via search snippet)

title: KTransformers DeepSeek-R1/V3 tutorial
supports: Decode 8.73 (1S, 32 cores) -> 11.26 tok/s (2S) on Xeon 6454S; weights duplicated per NUMA node (382 GB 1S vs 1 TB 2S). Taken from DD6 notes P1 [VERIFIED by p4], not re-opened by p5-PHY-r2

title: KT-Kernel MiniMax-M2.1 tutorial
supports: MiniMax-M2.1 FP8 decode 32.1 tok/s at 2k on 2x EPYC 9355 + 1x RTX 5090; 2,540 tok/s prefill at 32k. Taken from DD6 notes P2, not re-opened

title: KTransformers DeepSeek-V4-Flash doc
supports: Default MAX_RUNNING_REQUESTS = 2 for the S-class model on 1x RTX 5090. Taken from DD6 notes P8, not re-opened

title: KT-Kernel Kimi-K2-Thinking native INT4
supports: Kimi-K2-Thinking native INT4 needs >=650 GB RAM. Taken from DD6 notes P4, not re-opened

title: KGD 256Mbx16 DDR4 1.2V
supports: The KGD lot DD7 Track C4 proposes to buy is a 256M x16 = 4Gb x16 DDR4 die (from the listing slug as cited in DD7 s10), not the 8Gb x8 die of the MCM design

title: Storage of products supplied by Infineon Technologies
supports: Infineon limit of 36 months for unsawn wafers stored in nitrogen (as cited in DD7 s1; not re-opened)

title: Testing confirms component reliability remains with proper long-term storage
supports: Rochester study covers PACKAGED parts functional after up to 17 years; cited by DD7 for bare-die pull_yield 0.95 (category mismatch). As cited in DD7, not re-opened
